findings.location: items/lem-na-scott-zhang-boundary-preserving-p1-interpolant.md: sources.references[0] URL/locator and sources.references[1] locator (Chapter 5, Theorem 5.2.2, pp. 276–277)
findings.evidence: The cited Guermond [Chapter 49 PDF](https://people.tamu.edu/~guermond/M661_FALL_2025/chap49.pdf) concerns mixed-form well-posedness and does not contain the listed Chapters 50 and 53–54. In the [Boffi–Brezzi–Fortin textbook](https://www.karlin.mff.cuni.cz/~knobloch/FILES/Boffi-Brezzi-Fortin-Mixed_FEMs_and_Applications.pdf), Theorem 5.2.2 is a mixed saddle-point error estimate, not the face-average P1 interpolation result; the cited Chapter 8 sections concern Stokes stable elements. Scott and Zhang (1990), §§2–4, Theorem 2.1 and Theorem 4.1/Corollary 4.1, pp. 485–491, directly treats averaged nodal interpolation, homogeneous boundary preservation, stability, and approximation ([DOI](https://doi.org/10.1090/S0025-5718-1990-1011446-7)). The dependency item has a local proof, so this bibliographic defect does not invalidate the assigned consumer’s decomposition argument.
